text.text: payment-service is failing on two fronts: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion causing `DB_CONN_TIMEOUT` errors and upstream 504s from api-gateway, and a prod pod crash-looping with `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` plus `OOMKilled` events. auth-service is also degraded by Redis session lookup latency, producing `TOKEN_VALIDATION_FAILED` and 401s through api-gateway, and the recent payment-service deployment v2.8.4 is associated with increased errors and only 1/6 available replicas. Overall severity is P1, with immediate user impact on payments and authenticated access to protected endpoints. The single most critical next step is to roll back payment-service from v2.8.4 to v2.8.3 and restore stable replicas while traffic is shed to reduce pressure.

*Issues Identified:*
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `payment-service, postgres-primary, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *OOM_KILL* on `payment-service, kubelet, kubernetes` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *AUTH_ERROR* on `auth-service, redis-cache, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 97%)
• *DEPLOY_FAILURE* on `payment-service, deployment-controller, kubernetes` — P1 (confidence: 84%)
